page.overview:
Who is Derek "Decals" Dobbs?

Derek "Decals" Dobbs is a minor character in Cars. He is a Hollismobile Rumbler. He has an artistic streak.

"Derek "Decals" Dobbs came to Radiator Springs to find a job with his old pal Ramone, touching up paint jobs and giving clientele much needed facelifts. Derek not only paints cars, he also paints murals. He painted a beautiful mural on the side of one of the town shops, declaring Radiator Springs "A Happy Place.""

While Derek is driving to Radiator Springs, Percy Hanbrakes says "Morning" to him. Derek replies with "Nice day, huh?".
